title: ISNUMBER, ISTEXT, ISNONTEXT, and ISLOGICAL perform no coercion, treating numeric/logical text as text and rich images as ISNONTEXT TRUE
statement: In Excel 16.0 builds 20430 and 20527, ISNUMBER, ISTEXT, ISNONTEXT, and ISLOGICAL test the runtime value type without implicit conversion: ISNUMBER("19") and ISNUMBER(TRUE) are FALSE, ISLOGICAL("TRUE") and ISLOGICAL(0) are FALSE, ISTEXT("") is TRUE, and ISNONTEXT is TRUE for numbers, logicals, blank cells, worksheet errors, and _webimage pictures (while ISTEXT, ISNUMBER, and ISLOGICAL are FALSE for _webimage pictures). Each matches 1,227/1,227 full-bank and 120/120 pinned rows.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527.20196 (dc_nzpw rows 39-61, 152-155, 177-180), Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (jnt_logical_info rows 18-21, 115-130), Excel 16.0.20527 (fetch.rs rows 516-517), and 1,227/1,227 full-bank and 120/120 pinned rows for each function.
